artifacts.summary: Confirms all three gaps (bibkey resolution, docstring markdown links, C20 declaration-name checking) are real and unaddressed, but empirically shows the tree is currently clean on every one (0 dangling bibkeys, 0 broken docstring links, C20 both tiers green); proves --recompute is already idempotent by reproducing task 636's double-shift bug against a disposable clone; and surfaces the declaration-span design question for C20's strengthening with a live worked example.

next_steps: Run /plan 643 to create an implementation plan covering: (1) C31 bibkey-resolution check + advisory unused-bib report (two citation syntaxes: [key] in Lean, @key in Typst); (2) C32 docstring markdown-link check with a path-shaped filter to avoid false positives from inline math notation; (3) a --selftest addition to reanchor-lean-citations.py covering the double-run-then-recompute scenario, plus a fixture for a citer line edited for content in the same batch (recompute's known blind spot); (4) the C20 declaration-span cross-check mechanism (reusing C15's declaration-location logic), applied to Formula.lean, DerivedAxioms.lean and KPlusFaithful.lean with the residual bare-citation count recorded rather than driven to zero; (5) MODULE_INVARIANTS.md rows for C31/C32 and a REFERENCE_NORMAL_FORM.md pointer/update.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, a naive `\[.*?\]\(...\)` markdown-link regex over .lean docstrings produces heavy false positives in the FormalSystem/Metalogic/Expressiveness/Kamp/NfMultiAnchorBridge/ subtree, where inline math notation like `[z_0, z_1](x, y)` (function application written bracket-then-paren) parses as a link. Any future markdown-link-in-docstring scanner over this tree must require the link target to be path-shaped (matches a conservative path-token grammar and contains '/' or a recognized extension) before treating it as a link to resolve.

BimodalLogic's scripts/reanchor-lean-citations.py already has an idempotent --recompute mode (added by task 636) that repairs the documented double-run-of-the-Δ-pass bug: it recomputes each citation by diffing citer/target file content against a base revision and only rewrites a citer line whose content is byte-identical to the base except for the citation digits. Verified empirically (disposable clone, reproduced the double-shift on KPlusFaithful.lean's 72 citations, ran --recompute twice): the second run changes 0 lines. Known blind spot: a citer line that was ALSO content-edited (not just digit-shifted) in the same batch is silently left un-repaired, since the tool refuses rather than guesses.

BimodalLogic's typst/ tree cites bibliography entries with Typst's native @key syntax (e.g. @brastmckie2026construction), not the Lean-docstring [key] markdown-link-bracket syntax. Any 'which references.bib entries are cited by nothing' advisory scan across both trees needs two separate regexes unioned together, or it will over-report unused entries for every Typst-only-cited key.
